origin: Seoul Tourism Plaza / Myeongdong Info Center / Station Kiosks
destination: All Seoul Subway + City/Shuttle Buses (Days 2–8) + T-money (Busan Day 9)
recommendedMode: 7-Day Climate Card Short-Term Pass (Seoul) + 1 T-money Card per adult
stepByStep: Buy physical Climate Card (3,000 KRW) near Myeongdong -> load 7-Day Pass (20,000 KRW cash at Line 1–8 kiosk) for unlimited Seoul subways + Seoul buses (incl. Namsan 01A/01B!). Also carry T-money (3,000–5,000 KRW card at GS25/CU) for Busan Metro/buses on Day 9.
fareTwoAdults: 46,000 KRW for full week of unlimited Seoul transit
notes: IMPORTANT Oct 1, 2026 rule change: Climate Card works within Seoul boundaries only (excludes Sinbundang, GTX, AREX Express & Busan transit) — T-money covers everything outside Seoul.

destination: Stanford Hotel Myeongdong (84 Namdaemun-ro)
recommendedMode: Airport Limousine Bus 6015 (Best with suitcases)
stepByStep: Buy ticket at airport Limousine counter/kiosk first (required since 2026) -> board Bus 6015 at T2 B1 Stop 28 or T1 1F Exit 5 -> alight at 'Lotte Hotel / IBIS Myeong-dong' -> 2-min flat walk to hotel 9F elevator.
notes: Zero stairs or train transfers after a transpacific flight from SFO. Exact travel time left blank because official timetable notes road-traffic variance.

destination: Stanford Hotel Myeongdong (Rail Alternative)
recommendedMode: AREX Express Train + Line 4 Subway (or Taxi from Seoul Stn)
stepByStep: AREX Express nonstop ICN -> Seoul Station (43 min T1 / 51 min T2), then transfer Seoul Metro Line 4 -> Myeongdong Station (2 stops) OR short taxi to 84 Namdaemun-ro.
notes: Draft listed '$7 / 45 min'; official Express fare is 13,000 KRW to Seoul Station only. Budget rail alternative: AREX All-Stop (~59 min T1 / 66 min T2) -> Hongik Univ. transfer Line 2 direct to Euljiro 1(il)-ga Exit 5.

destination: N Seoul Tower (105 Namsangongwon-gil)
recommendedMode: Namsan Sunhwan Green Shuttle Bus 01A or 01B
stepByStep: Board Namsan Circular Bus 01A (every 9 min) or 01B (every 14 min) near Chungmuro / Myeongdong area -> ride directly to N Seoul Tower summit bus stop -> 4-min uphill walk to Plaza.
notes: Runs 06:30–23:00 daily. Alternative scenic option: walk 12 min to Namsan Cable Car (83 Sopa-ro; 15,000 KRW round-trip / 12,000 KRW one-way adult).
officialSourceLabel: N SEOUL TOWER Official — Bus Guide

destination: Gwangjang Market (88 Changgyeonggung-ro)
recommendedMode: Seoul Metro Line 2 (No transfers)
stepByStep: Enter Euljiro 1(il)-ga Station (`202`, 2-min walk from hotel) -> ride Green Line 2 east 2 stops to Euljiro 4(sa)-ga Station (`204`, Exit 4) -> walk 100m north into Gwangjang Market.
notes: Within 10 km base distance zone on Seoul Metro.

destination: Mangwon Market (27 Poeun-ro 6-gil, Mapo-gu)
recommendedMode: Seoul Metro Line 2 -> Line 6 (1 transfer)
stepByStep: Line 2 at Euljiro 1(il)-ga (`202`) westbound -> transfer at Hapjeong (`238`) to Brown Line 6 -> 1 stop to Mangwon Station (`621`, Exit 2) -> 5-min walk.
farePerAdult: 1,550 KRW (T-money card base fare within 10 km)
notes: Integrated transit card transfer costs zero extra base fare when tapping within 30 minutes.
officialSourceLabel: Seoul Metro Official — Transfer & Fare Rules

day: Day 3 (Move from Tue Nov 3 -> Wed Nov 4!)
destination: Gyeongbokgung Palace -> Cafe Onion Anguk -> Bukchon Hanok Village
recommendedMode: Seoul Metro Line 2 -> Line 3 (1 quick transfer)
stepByStep: Euljiro 1(il)-ga (`202`) -> 1 stop to Euljiro 3(sam)-ga (`203`) -> transfer Orange Line 3 -> Gyeongbokgung Station (`327`, Exit 5 opens right inside Palace gate!). Walk east after lunch to Anguk Station (`328`, Exit 2/3) for Cafe Onion & Bukchon.
notes: REMINDER: Do NOT take this trip for Gyeongbokgung on Tuesday Nov 3 (Palace & Guard Ceremony closed Tuesdays!). Swap with Day 4 (Wednesday Nov 4)!

day: Day 4 (Wed Nov 4 — or Tue Nov 3 if swapped)
destination: DDP (Dongdaemun) -> Seongsu-dong ('Brooklyn of Seoul')
recommendedMode: Seoul Metro Line 2 Direct (Zero transfers!)
stepByStep: Euljiro 1(il)-ga (`202`) -> 3 stops east to Dongdaemun History & Culture Park (`205`, Exit 1 for DDP) -> continue 6 stops east on same Line 2 to Seongsu Station (`211`, Exits 2/3/4 for Onion, Jayeondo, Musinsa, Hanjungsun!).
notes: Both DDP and Seongsu sit on the exact same Green Line 2 loop directly outside Stanford Hotel Myeongdong.

destination: Starfield COEX Mall, Starfield Library & Gangnam Style Statue
recommendedMode: Seoul Metro Line 2 Direct (Zero transfers)
stepByStep: Euljiro 1(il)-ga (`202`) -> ride Green Line 2 direct to Samseong Station (`219`, Exits 5 & 6 connect straight inside underground COEX Mall & Starfield Library; Exit 6 surface plaza for Gangnam Style Statue).
farePerAdult: 1,650 KRW (T-money card: 1,550 KRW base + 100 KRW >10 km increment)
notes: Direct single-train ride from hotel door without changing lines.
officialSourceLabel: Visit Seoul Official — Starfield Library Access

destination: Ikseon-dong & Insadong (Rain Report Rainbow, Jayeondo, Chwihyang)
recommendedMode: 18-min scenic walk OR Subway Line 2 -> Line 3 to Jongno 3-ga
stepByStep: Subway: Euljiro 1(il)-ga -> Euljiro 3(sam)-ga -> Line 3 (1 stop) to Jongno 3(sam)-ga Station Exit 4 (280m walk to Rain Report Rainbow & Ikseon alleys; cross Samil-daero west into Insadong).
notes: Jongno 3(sam)-ga Exit 4 puts you right at the mouth of Ikseon-dong Hanok Village.
officialSourceLabel: Visit Seoul Official — Rain Report Rainbow Directions

destination: Itaewon District
recommendedMode: Seoul Metro Line 4 -> Line 6 (or Blue City Bus via Namsan Tunnel)
stepByStep: Walk to Myeongdong Station (Line 4) -> 2 stops south to Samgakji -> transfer Brown Line 6 (2 stops east) to Itaewon Station.
notes: Remember to tap your T-money card BOTH boarding and alighting on Korean buses to keep free transfers active.
officialSourceLabel: Seoul Metropolitan Gov — Subway & Bus Transfers

destination: Busan Station (KTX High-Speed Rail)
recommendedMode: Taxi/Uber to Seoul Stn + KORAIL KTX to Busan Station
stepByStep: Check out of Stanford Hotel Myeongdong (9F) by ~10:00 AM -> quick taxi/Uber (or Line 4, 2 stops) to Seoul Station -> check Departure Board ~20 min before train -> board KTX to Busan Station.
farePerAdult: Subway to Seoul Stn: 1,550 KRW | KTX & Taxi: Unverified until train booked
notes: Book KTX seats in advance via official KORAIL website/app (korail.com); no ticket turnstiles exist at Seoul Station, so head down as soon as platform number posts ~15–20 min early for suitcase racks.

destination: L7 HAEUNDAE by LOTTE -> Haeundae Beach & Haeundae Market
recommendedMode: Taxi/Uber with bags OR Busan Metro Line 1 -> Line 2 (Haeundae Stn Exit 5)
stepByStep: Public Transit Option: Busan Metro Line 1 (Busan Stn -> Seomyeon) -> transfer Line 2 to Haeundae Station Exit 5 -> flat walk along Gunam-ro to L7 HAEUNDAE (55 Haeun-daero 570beon-gil; 3F Check-in). Beach & Haeundae Market are both 3–5 min walks from hotel!
notes: Busan Station to Haeundae Station route and Haeundae Station Exit 3/5 walking access (5 min) confirmed on official VisitBusan & Busan Metropolitan City pages.

origin: Busan Metropolitan Area (Metro Lines 1–4, City Bus, Village Bus)
destination: All Busan Attractions (Haeundae, Gwangalli, Gamcheon, Songdo, Nampo-dong)
recommendedMode: T-money / Cashbee Card (Free 30-Min Busan Transfer Discount)
stepByStepRoute: Tap the SAME T-money/transit card when boarding and alighting Busan Metro, City Buses, and Village Micro Buses. Up to 2 transfers within 30 minutes are free (paying only the 50 KRW mode difference between ordinary bus 1,550 KRW and metro 1,600 KRW). Note: Seoul's Climate Card does NOT work in Busan.
verifiedFare: Metro: 1,600 KRW (Sec 1) / 1,800 KRW (Sec 2) | Ordinary Bus: 1,550 KRW | Express Bus: 2,100 KRW | Metro 1-Day Pass: 6,000 KRW / 3-Day Pass: 13,000 KRW
officialSourceLabel: Busan Transportation Corp. — Official Fare & Transfer Guide

destination: Haeundae Beach -> Haeundae Amso Galbijip -> Dongbaekseom Island & Nurimaru APEC House
recommendedMode: Walking along Haeundae Beach Boardwalk
stepByStepRoute: 1. Walk 3–4 min south down Gunam-ro to Haeundae Beach. 2. For Haeundae Amso Galbijip (32-10 Jungdong 2-ro 10beon-gil, opens 11:30), walk ~10 min east toward Jung-dong (or 1 stop on Line 2 to Jung-dong Station Exit 7). 3. Walk west along the full length of Haeundae Beach to Dongbaekseom Island trailhead and follow the coastal boardwalk loop to Nurimaru APEC House (116 Dongbaek-ro).
verifiedDuration: 3–4 min to beach; ~10 min to Amso Galbijip; ~15 min to Nurimaru APEC House

destination: Haeundae Blueline Park Mipo Station -> Sky Capsule to Cheongsapo & Daritdol Observatory
recommendedMode: Beachfront Walk or Village Bus Haeundae-gu 2 / City Bus 100, 139, 141 + Sky Capsule / Beach Train
stepByStepRoute: 1. To Mipo Station (13 Dalmaji-gil 62beon-gil): Walk ~15–18 min east along Haeundae Beach promenade past LCT Tower, OR take Village Bus Haeundae-gu 2 / City Bus 100, 139, 141 to Mipo (Mungtangeori) stop. 2. Board reserved Sky Capsule from Mipo -> Cheongsapo (~30 min, 2 km elevated rail). 3. At Cheongsapo Station, walk 5–8 min east to Cheongsapo Daritdol Observatory (167 Cheongsapo-ro). 4. Return to Mipo/Haeundae via Haeundae Beach Train, reverse Sky Capsule, or Village Bus Haeundae-gu 2 direct to Haeundae Station.
verifiedDuration: ~15 min walk or ~8 min bus to Mipo + 30 min Sky Capsule + 5–8 min walk to Daritdol
verifiedFare: Bus: 1,550 KRW | Daritdol Skywalk: Free | Sky Capsule / Beach Train: book in advance on bluelinepark.com
officialSourceLabel: VisitKorea — Haeundae Blueline Park & Cheongsapo Daritdol

origin: L7 HAEUNDAE by LOTTE (Haeundae Station Line 2)
destination: Gamcheon Culture Village & Coffee It House (203 Gamnae 2-ro / 115 Okcheon-ro, Saha-gu)
recommendedMode: Busan Metro Line 2 -> Line 1 (Toseong Station Exit 6) -> Village Bus Saha 1-1 / Seo-gu 2 / Seo-gu 2-2
stepByStepRoute: 1. Walk 4 min from L7 HAEUNDAE to Haeundae Station (Line 2). 2. Ride Line 2 west to Seomyeon Station (~31 min, 16 stops) -> transfer to Line 1 southbound toward Dadaepo -> alight at Toseong Station (토성역, ~20 min, 10 stops). 3. Exit via Toseong Station Exit 6, turn right around the corner to the 'Pusan National University Hospital (부산대학교병원)' stop in front of the Cancer Center. 4. Board Village Bus Saha 1-1, Seo-gu 2, or Seo-gu 2-2 (~10 min uphill) to 'Gamcheon Elementary School / Gamcheon Culture Village' stop (Coffee It House is 2 min away at 115 Okcheon-ro).
verifiedDuration: ~65–72 min total (faster and more reliable than taking 2 city buses across downtown traffic)
verifiedFare: ~1,800 KRW adult total with T-money free 30-minute metro-to-village-bus transfer

destination: BIFF Square & Jagalchi Market (Nampo-dong, Jung-gu)
recommendedMode: Village Bus Seo-gu 2 / Seo-gu 2-2 / Saha 1-1 Downhill
stepByStepRoute: Board Village Bus Seo-gu 2 or Seo-gu 2-2 at the Gamcheon Culture Village stop (across from the main arch / Coffee It House) riding downhill past Toseong Station directly to Jagalchi Station / Chungmu-dong Intersection (~15–18 min). Walk 3 min east to BIFF Square (4 Nampo-gil) and 6–9 min south to Jagalchi Fish Market (52 Jagalchihaean-ro).
verifiedDuration: ~15–18 min village bus ride + 3–9 min walk

origin: Jagalchi Market / BIFF Square (Chungmu-dong / Jagalchi Station)
destination: Songdo Beach, Songdo Cloud Trails & Songdo Marine Cable Car (Seo-gu)
recommendedMode: Busan City Bus 6, 26, 30, 71, or 96
stepByStepRoute: Walk to the Jagalchi Station / Chungmu-dong Intersection bus stop and board City Bus 6, 26, 30, 71, or 96 southwest for ~7 stops (~12–15 min ride) to 'Songdo Beach (송도해수욕장)' stop. Walk ~5–9 min down to Songdo Beach, head to the eastern end for Songdo Cloud Trails (129-4 Amnam-dong) and Songdo Bay Cable Car Station (171 Songdohaebyeon-ro).
verifiedDuration: ~13 min bus ride + 5–9 min walk (matches draft's '13 min bus ride, 9 min walk')
officialSourceLabel: VisitKorea — Songdo Beach & Busan Air Cruise

origin: Songdo Beach -> Old Downtown (Gukje Market / Nampo-dong) -> L7 HAEUNDAE
destination: Gukje Market & Gwangbok-ro Shopping Streets -> Return to L7 HAEUNDAE
recommendedMode: City Bus 6/26/30/71/96 to Nampo-dong -> Busan Metro Line 1 + Line 2 back to Haeundae
stepByStepRoute: 1. Take City Bus 6, 26, 30, 71, or 96 from Songdo Beach back to Jagalchi Station / BIFF Square (~13 min, 1,550 KRW). 2. Walk through BIFF Square north across Gudeok-ro into Gukje Market (Sinchang-dong 4-ga) and east along Gwangbok-dong Cultural & Fashion Street (72-1 Gwangbok-ro). 3. Return to hotel: Enter Nampo Station or Jagalchi Station (Line 1) -> ride to Seomyeon Station -> transfer to Line 2 -> Haeundae Station Exit 5 (~50 min, 1,800 KRW).
verifiedDuration: ~13 min bus Songdo->Nampo; ~50 min Metro Nampo->Haeundae
verifiedFare: 1,550 KRW bus + 1,800 KRW metro (or free transfer within 30 min)

destination: BUSAN X the SKY (30 Dalmaji-gil) & SEA LIFE Busan Aquarium (266 Haeundaehaebyeon-ro)
recommendedMode: Walking along Haeundae Beach Promenade (+ Optional Line 2 to Centum City for Shopping)
stepByStepRoute: 1. Walk ~12 min (900 m) east from L7 HAEUNDAE along Haeundae Beach to LCT Landmark Tower 1F for BUSAN X the SKY (10:00–11:30). 2. Walk ~8 min (600 m) west along the beachfront promenade to SEA LIFE Busan Aquarium (266 Haeundaehaebyeon-ro, right at the foot of Gunam-ro, 5 min from L7 HAEUNDAE). 3. For Haeundae shopping, browse Gunam-ro or take Line 2 from Haeundae Station 3 stops west to Centum City Station (~7 min, 1,600 KRW) for Shinsegae & Lotte Department Stores.
verifiedFare: Free (Walking) | 1,600 KRW if taking Line 2 to Centum City

origin: L7 HAEUNDAE by LOTTE (Haeundae Station Line 2)
destination: Gwangalli Beach (219 Gwanganhaebyeon-ro) for 19:00 Gwangalli M Drone Light Show
recommendedMode: Busan Metro Line 2 Direct (Haeundae Station <-> Gwangan Station)
stepByStepRoute: 1. Walk 4 min from L7 HAEUNDAE to Haeundae Station (Busan Metro Line 2). 2. Ride Line 2 westbound 5 stops (Haeundae -> Dongbaek -> BEXCO -> Centum City -> Millak -> Gwangan, ~11 min ride). 3. Exit via Gwangan Station Exit 3 or Exit 5 and walk straight south ~8–10 min (700 m) to Gwangalli Beach for dinner and the 19:00 Drone Show. 4. Reverse the exact same Line 2 route back to Haeundae Station after the show.
verifiedDuration: ~23 min door-to-door each way (4 min walk + 11 min subway + 8 min walk)
verifiedFare: 1,600 KRW adult each way (Section 1 transit card)

destination: Busan Station -> KTX to Seoul Station
recommendedMode: Busan Metro Line 2 -> Line 1 (or Express Bus 1001/1003 or Uber/Taxi) + KORAIL KTX
stepByStepRoute: 1. Check out of L7 HAEUNDAE by 11:00 AM. 2. To Busan Station: Either take Uber/Kakao T taxi (~40–60 min depending on Gwangandaegyo/Busanhangdaegyo bridge traffic), OR take Busan Metro Line 2 Haeundae Station -> Seomyeon Station -> transfer Line 1 -> Busan Station (~42 min, 1,800 KRW, zero traffic delay), OR Express Bus 1001/1003 (2,100 KRW). 3. Board KTX at Busan Station to Seoul Station (~2 hr 30 min–2 hr 50 min).
verifiedDuration: ~42 min by Metro (or ~40–60 min by taxi) + ~2 hr 45 min KTX
verifiedFare: Metro: 1,800 KRW (or Express Bus 2,100 KRW) + KTX Standard: 54,400 KRW adult
officialSourceLabel: KORAIL — Official KTX Booking & Busan Metro

destination: Mercure Ambassador Seoul Hongdae (144 Yanghwa-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul)
recommendedMode: AREX All-Stop Train (Seoul Station -> Hongik Univ. Station) + Short Walk via Exit 8 (Elevator) or Exit 9
stepByStepRoute: 1. At Seoul Station KTX platforms, follow signs down to B3 Airport Railroad **AREX All-Stop Train (일반열차)** — do NOT board the B2 Express Train (Express runs nonstop to Incheon Airport and skips Hongdae!). 2. Tap T-money card and ride AREX All-Stop 2 stops west (Seoul Station -> Gongdeok -> Hongik Univ. Station, ~7 min ride). 3. Follow underground signs (~5–6 min indoor walk) toward Line 2 Exit 8 (has elevator for luggage, ~4–5 min street walk via rear alley) or Exit 9 (stairs, ~2 min walk) to Mercure Ambassador Seoul Hongdae (144 Yanghwa-ro, 4F lobby).
verifiedDuration: ~7 min AREX train ride + ~6–8 min station-to-hotel walk (~15 min total)
verifiedFare: 1,550 KRW adult (T-money urban rail base fare)
officialSourceLabel: Accor Official & Seoul Metro / AREX Guide
